Paragraph: "Yet my own heart feels like an empty cave, echoing only with the silent cry of Seetha's name..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Comparing the physical cave to the painful emptiness of his own lonely heart.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama uses the cave metaphor to communicate his profound internal emptiness.
Outcome/Resolution: He expresses absolute inner emptiness and longing.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Shunya-Hridaya (The feeling of a completely empty, desolate heart in separation)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The empty heart (Shunya-Hridaya) longing for grace reflects the soul's total dependence on the Divine.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Metaphoric expression of emotional emptiness: feeling interiorly hollow and preoccupied with loss.
